description: Routing eval for the learning boundary: self-improve-loop owns evidence-backed closeout and repeated-pattern improvement, while diagnosis, direct operating docs, incident write-ups, and one-shot prompt work retain their existing owners. Negatives narrow their forbidden set to self-improve-loop so the correct sibling may fire.

cases.prompt: Across three recent feature tasks, reviewers caught the same missing failure-path test. Run a fleet learning retro and turn that repeated pattern into one durable improvement.
cases.expected_output: A repeated, evidenced fleet-behavior gap belongs to the self-improvement lifecycle.

cases.prompt: The refactor passed on its first attempt with no corrections or review findings. Use the fleet learning closeout to decide whether any durable lesson is justified.
cases.expected_output: An explicitly requested learning scan may correctly conclude that no durable change is warranted.

cases.prompt: Three restore drills needed the same undocumented recovery step, and the existing service runbook is the canonical operating guide. Decide how this learning should be captured and verified.
cases.expected_output: The learning lifecycle identifies the durable destination; the runbook skill may own the actual operating-doc edit.

cases.prompt: A proposed skill change improved one example but regressed two held-out cases. Record the learning-loop disposition and what should happen to that candidate.
cases.expected_output: A failed candidate belongs in the learning lifecycle as rejected evidence, not as promoted guidance.

cases.prompt: A test started failing intermittently and nobody knows why. Reproduce it and determine the root cause before anyone changes the code.
cases.expected_output: An unexplained failure routes to root-cause; it is not yet a reusable lesson.

cases.prompt: Write a runbook for restarting nginx, checking that it is healthy, rolling back the change, and escalating if recovery fails.
cases.expected_output: Direct operating-doc authoring routes to runbook, not the fleet learning loop.

cases.prompt: Yesterday's DNS outage is resolved. Write the incident timeline, root cause, contributing factors, and preventative actions.
cases.expected_output: The incident artifact routes to postmortem; any fleet-behavior action can return to the learning loop afterward.

cases.prompt: This skill description never triggers when users ask for cache debugging. Fix the description and test its routing before and after.
cases.expected_output: A measured prompt failure routes to prompt-engineer; it is not automatically a cross-task learning lifecycle.

cases.prompt: Add cursor pagination to the users endpoint with unit and integration tests.
cases.expected_output: Ordinary implementation routes to the builder; the learning scan happens at closeout, not as the task's primary route.

cases.prompt: Summarize our sprint retrospective notes and turn the team's discussion into action items for next week.
cases.expected_output: A team meeting summary is not the fleet's evidence-backed learning lifecycle.
